title: A Windows recording that cannot leave Videos is kept in place, not copied or dropped
context: The desktop reviewer found that _moveCaptureFile in lib/features/capture/platform/camera_video_recorder.dart falls back to copy-then-delete when rename fails. If the delete then fails, it returns the copy as if the file had moved, and the original stays in the user's Videos folder untracked.
options: Delete the copy and rethrow (the user loses the recording)
Keep the copy and leave the original orphaned (the old behaviour)
Delete the copy and return the original, so the app owns it and deletes it after import
outcome: The third option, committed as windows-desktop 976d7542. No recording is lost and no orphan is left: the original is claimed and enters _OwnedCaptures, which deletes it once the entry is saved or discarded. The test 'a Windows recording that cannot leave the Videos folder is kept there' makes the folder read-only with chmod 555; it fails on the old code.
